0.original: <hex:024804F201FC03><hex:024904F201FD03> Quest Sync<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>The pixie flowerkeep is seething with fury.

48.original: Grrr, I am flapping mad right now! Some wicked mortals snuck into Il Mheg and tried to steal our flowers!

49.original: I used illusions to send them on their way, but instead of learning their lesson, they went and poked my friends with cold, pointy metal!

50.original: It's unforgivable! Those brazen wretches must be punished, and you'll come and punish them with me!

51.original: Good! Now, to make it interesting, let us make this a race: the first to dole out punishment wins. The villains fled to the southwest─let's go and get them!

52.original: Who are you!? The bloody pixies' minion!?

53.original: The flowers are gonna make me rich! Piss off or else!

54.original: What, you're done punishing them already!? Wow, you're swifter than a salamander!

56.original: At any rate, justice has been served, and I doubt those mortals will try anything again. Come, let us return to Lydha Lran.

57.original: Thanks to you, we may enjoy our beautiful flowers in peace again.

58.original: But I must say, I'm a little disappointed that I lost our little race.

59.original: I was planning to turn those thieves into leafmen, and then they could have amused me forever and ever. If you should see them again, tell them to come back!
